01 / 08 Automotive

Automotives STA

Car repair workshop · St Albans, United Kingdom

From the exterior to the engineering behind the motion.

Visit the site (opens in a new tab)

02 The project

A one-page website for a car repair company in St Albans, built around a scroll-driven scene: a light reveals the car, a scan line turns it to wireframe, the engine opens into its groups and the parts land in the service cards.

  • Scroll-driven 2.5D scene
  • Layers registered with OpenCV
  • Vite

03 The direction

Composition
The car fills the whole scene; the text sits in a narrow column, never competing with the machine.
Typography
Heavy uppercase Inter Tight for headings and JetBrains Mono for technical labels.
Colour
Black, silver and a single red, with a cold blue kept for the scan line.
Central gesture
A scan line crosses the bodywork and reveals the mechanics.

The site’s palette

  • Base#08090B
  • White#F4F3EF
  • Silver#ADB4BC
  • Red#E63B32
  • Scan blue#CFE9FF
